meta.title: Free Kundali Online — Vedic Birth Chart | Marg Darshan
meta.description: Enter your birth date, time and place to get your Lagna chart, planetary positions, Vimshottari dasha and dosha analysis — completely free.
meta.resultDescription: Lagna, Rashi, Nakshatra, planetary positions, dasha periods and dosha & yoga analysis.

page.title: Your birth chart,
page.lead: Precise Vedic calculations on the Lahiri ayanamsa — your Lagna chart, planetary positions and dasha periods in seconds.
page.chartsBody: Your Lagna chart in North and South Indian styles, with exact planetary degrees.
page.dashaBody: Vimshottari mahadasha and antardasha — which period is running now and until when.
page.doshaBody: Manglik, Kaal Sarp, Sade Sati and other doshas, plus the auspicious yogas in your chart.
page.pdfBody: A detailed PDF kundali will soon be emailed to you as well.
page.privacy: Your details are kept private — we never share them with anyone.
